reading.title: Vegetables 1: Planning Meals with Vegetables
reading.text: Hala buys carrot, potato, sweet potato, beet and turnip for soup. A parsnip and a piece of ginger are for another recipe. She compares yam with rutabaga but leaves both today. reading.title: Vegetables 4: Planning Meals with Vegetables
reading.text: A cook prepares soup with onion, garlic, leek, shallot and scallion. One chive goes on the finished dish as a garnish. Celery and fennel go in the pot, while asparagus and artichoke are for another meal. Habanero, serrano and poblano peppers stay in a separate basket. Cayenne and paprika are in small spice jars, but the soup does not need them today.
reading.imageBrief: Kitchen counter with onion, garlic, leek, shallot, scallions, chives, celery and fennel; small separate peppers and unlabelled paprika jar. No heat-level diagnosis from appearance.
